agent_explanation: Body launched upward at ~38.4 m/s hits underside of thin static wall around step 76. Restitution e=0.1 should leave rebound speed ~3.8 m/s, but observed rebound is 45.2 m/s (faster than impact). With controller disabled (work 0) and gravity conservative, this ~300 J jump can only come from the contact solver: at high approach speed with tiny dt, impulse plus positional (Baumgarte) correction pushes the body out along the contact normal and adds velocity in the same direction as the bounce, injecting energy instead of dissipating it.
